subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu(Lark) Webhook URL verification fails with 401 Invalid signature when encryptKey is set

question: Should Feishu webhook setup accept unsigned encrypted `url_verification` challenges when the decrypted verification token matches, while continuing to reject unsigned non-challenge events?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix deliberately changes a pre-auth webhook boundary and needs maintainer/security intent before automation should alter it.

options.title: Approve narrow bootstrap challenge path
options.body: Allow a guarded challenge-first path only for encrypted `url_verification` payloads with a matching verification token, and keep normal event delivery fail-closed on signatures.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep implementation paused until a maintainer or contributor supplies a redacted real Feishu Developer Console callback trace showing the exact unsigned encrypted challenge shape.

options.title: Keep strict signature-only webhook setup
options.body: Leave current webhook behavior unchanged and direct affected users to dispatcher mode, accepting that Feishu webhook setup remains blocked for this reported platform behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow bootstrap challenge path
recommendation.body: Allow a guarded challenge-first path only for encrypted `url_verification` payloads with a matching verification token, and keep normal event delivery fail-closed on signatures.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the fail-closed webhook auth path and adjacent hardening commits, making them the best available routing candidate for the security-boundary choice.
